candidates.title: India's US oil and gas imports plunged 43% in September as West Asia supplies recovered despite Trump’s push: Report
candidates.excerpt: India’s imports of US crude oil, LNG and LPG fell 43% in September to a five-month low, while supplies from West Asia surged 67%. The shift comes as Gulf exports recover and US President Donald Trump pushes New Delhi to buy more American energy.

candidates.title: Pleas filed in SC, Delhi HC against de-notification of Jantar Mantar as protest site
candidates.excerpt: The application was filed on Wednesday by IYC president Uday Bhanu Chib in a pending petition over the denial of permission to hold the demonstration at Jantar Mantar in central Delhi. The organisation has challenged a standing order issued on October 11. The order removed Jantar Mantar from the list of designated protest sites and named Ramlila Ground, Burari Ground and CBD Ground in east Delhi as alternative venues.
